meta.source: Example brand for the Design Engineer Agent. Northwind Outfitters is fictional: replace this pack with your own brand's tokens (copied from your design system), or use it to see how brand packs work.
meta.tiers: Global (colour, type, space-1..5) → semantic (page margin, gutter) → component (button, card, key figure). Components use the tiers above them, never raw values.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and small text on light grounds; headings on light grounds.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Dark grounds: footer, hero overlay panels.

tokens.name: fjord
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour: buttons, links, active states, key-figure rules. White on fjord passes AA for text.

tokens.name: fjord-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of fjord surfaces.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: Secondary: tags and illustrations. Not for body text.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: The one accent: sale badges and the active rule on dark grounds. Never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Tinted grounds: table headers, zebra rows, section bands.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Text on dark grounds and photos; page background.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Space Grotesk Bold. One product figure per page. Web 56–112px fluid.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Built for the long way round
styles.usage: Space Grotesk Bold, sentence case. Page and section titles. Web 36–56px fluid.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.sample: Light enough for a day, tough enough for a season
styles.usage: Space Grotesk Medium, fjord. One benefit line under the title.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Every pack is tested on 200 km of trail.
styles.usage: Source Sans 3 Medium. Intro paragraph. Web 18–20px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Waxed canvas, aluminium frame, lifetime repairs.
styles.usage: Source Sans 3 Regular, ink, left aligned, never justified. Figures and units in Medium.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Source Sans 3 Medium, +0.04em. Key-figure labels and table headers.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything is square: buttons, cards, images, inputs.

tokens.name: inactive
tokens.usage: Disabled controls only (never unselected tabs: those stay full strength for contrast).

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Night panel over photos, on the fill only.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: Open menus and dialogs only. Cards are flat.

format.name: web
format.note: A web-first brand: lengths are screen px.
